image_description: A side-front view of a compact, boxy minibus parked on a paved street. The vehicle features a two-tone color scheme (beige/cream lower body and dark brown/black upper front) with red accents. It has a large windshield, a row of side passenger windows, and visible wheels. The background shows urban buildings and a spire.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof, short-wheelbase proportions of a minibus, distinct from full-size transit buses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible, along with multiple side windows indicating a passenger compartment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is consistent with a standing-headroom minibus. A door frame is visible behind the front wheel arch.
The vertical seam and handle placement near the front wheel indicate the presence of an entrance door mechanism.
The short hood and grille area ahead of the windshield confirm a front-engine layout typical of this class.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is occluded by the viewing angle; only the side and front are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle displays a specific multi-color livery (beige/brown/red) which fits the 'company livery' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wheels are proportional to the vehicle size, appearing as standard heavy-duty van/minibus tires.
The window count and overall dimensions align with the capacity of a 4-10 passenger minibus.

artifact_observations.location: Front destination sign and side body text
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the digital destination board above the windshield is illegible and structurally nonsensical. Similarly, the red lettering on the side panel appears distorted and unreadable, typical of AI generation struggles with typography.

artifact_observations.location: Lower body panels and wheel wells
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is slight smudging and lack of sharp definition in the panel gaps and around the wheel arches, giving a slightly 'painted' rather than mechanical look.
The geometry of the front bumper and headlight assembly is slightly warped and lacks precise mechanical symmetry, with soft edges where hard lines should exist.

alignment_reasoning: The image strongly conforms to the 'minibus' class. All testable geometric and functional checkpoints are present, including the correct silhouette, window arrangement, and wheel proportions. The only untestable checkpoint was the rear view due to occlusion.
artifact_reasoning: While the overall structure is sound, there are noticeable AI artifacts. The most significant issue is text gibberish on the destination sign and side livery. Additionally, there are minor structural softness issues in the front bumper geometry and texture smudging around the wheels, preventing a perfect artifact score.
